title: Chrome DevTools MCP = X-ray vision for frontend
description: Chrome DevTools MCP is insane for frontend dev. It gives your agent X-ray vision into the browser while it tests what youre building - it reads console logs, runtime errors, stack traces, hydration issues, failed API calls, bad auth headers, CORS errors, missing assets. It does DOM inspection so it sees what actually rendered, not just what your React or Vue tried to render. It can even check session cookies, auth state, local and session storage. Pair it with the Playwright MCP and your agent can drive the browser AND inspect every code-relevant error as it navigates, a real testing and validation loop. I think thats the ultimate setup for agent frontend development. Comment Chrome and Ill send you the links to both tools.
